text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It happened quite a while ago. At the 
beach—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh no... I was playing on the beach, and 
now my face is covered in sand...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Quickly, with seawater... No, I must wash 
my face with clean tap water...
choice_data_list: You don't want to get your face dirty?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm not very fond of it. Of course, 
in a race, I wouldn't mind getting dirty, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
If I can win without tarnishing my face or 
my race record, all the better. That is 
how I see it.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Do you think so as well, Trainer-dono?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, well, winning cleanly would be 
better...

Yeah, well, winning cleanly would be nice, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I see. If that is what you wish—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I think I will aim for it. To become a 
pure, unstained holy knight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether he remembered that or not, 
Durandal—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Durandal wins back-to-back Yasuda Kinen 
titles!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Winning this race in the Classic Year is 
extraordinarily difficult. On top of that, 
an unbelievable back-to-back victory!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Durandal defends her Sprinters Stakes 
title! She cannot be stopped here either!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Durandal has remarkably won back-to-back 
Mile Championships!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Victory after victory, defending title 
after title! Has there ever been a sprint 
Umamusume to carve out such a phenomenal 
record?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"A holy knight must remain pure and 
immaculate. That is why—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I won't let anyone defile it. No one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back-to-back victories in the Yasuda 
Kinen, Sprinters Stakes, and Mile 
Championship. That is truly—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was an immaculate, breathtakingly 
beautiful record.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As an absolute knight of the sprint 
division. The trust she earned from other 
Umamusume was unshakable.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All right, today is the inter-team mock 
race. Let's all do our best.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Umm... The representative for the shortest 
1200m distance is...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'll ask Durandal.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Huh? Are you sure you're fine with me?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Because there are barely any 
Umamusume on this team who specialize in 
short distances.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Durandal-san, I look forward to working 
with you!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes, then I shall gladly accept this 
important duty.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are many renowned Umamusume, but 
among those who shared a similar destiny, 
none achieved as much in sprint distances 
as Durandal.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Splendid, simply splendid! I could 
not be prouder!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, we have won the team 
competition. This glory—I dedicate to you.
choice_data_list: Thanks! That was another clean win today.

Thanks! That was another clean win today, 
wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A holy knight covered in mud wouldn't 
do. However...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"What I wanted to keep unstained the 
most... wasn't my face."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
If anything, that was the driving force 
behind me achieving such great results.
choice_data_list:
Something you want to protect from being 
defiled even more?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What could be more precious than your own 
face that you wouldn't want dirtied?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the reason I was able to win this 
much. The one thing I never want tainted 
is...
choice_data_list: What is it you don't want tarnished...?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: It goes without saying. That is—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono... It is your "fame."
